report.headline: Migration to ML-DSA-87 is INCOMPATIBLE: bootloader self-update unsupported; candidate INDETERMINATE due to missing dual-signature and interruption evidence.

main_causes.text: The declared transition requires a bootloader self-update, but the board does not support it (E11 UNSUPPORTED), violating REQ-BOOT-S0S1 for both transition steps.
Critical invariant INV-I2 (transition step S0-S1) is UNKNOWN because no evidence was provided for the step's behavior.
Critical invariants INV-I3 and INV-I4 are UNKNOWN due to missing dual-signature policy (GAP-O05) and missing interruption/atomicity evidence (GAP-E10, GAP-E12).

verified.text: Boot works in both states S0 and S1 (E01, E02 BOOT_OK), satisfying INV-I1.
The transitional verifier rejects a factory image with the wrong signing key (E03 REJECT), satisfying REQ-AUTH-NEGATIVE.
The signed factory image (12,876 bytes) fits the boot partition capacity (262,144 bytes), satisfying REQ-LAYOUT.
The image header size (12,288 bytes) matches the measured header span (12,288 bytes).
An application update script is present (E08).
Bootloader sizes for both generations are within the expected range (G1: 23,652 bytes; G2: 22,840 bytes).

unknowns.text: RAM/stack usage within budget is UNKNOWN because stack painting was not run (GAP-E07).
The dual-signature policy (AND/OR) is UNKNOWN because the dual build failed (GAP-O05, EV-T3-DUAL-BUILD).
Interruption behavior is UNKNOWN because event-based interruption was not observed (GAP-E10).
Non-atomic update window is UNKNOWN because the interrupted update recovery was not observed (GAP-E12).
The transition step S0-S1 behavior is UNKNOWN because no evidence was provided for INV-I2.

report.executive_summary: The migration from ECDSA P-256 to ML-DSA-87 is INCOMPATIBLE because the declared transition requires a bootloader self-update, which is unsupported on this board (E11 UNSUPPORTED). This blocks the transition verdict. The candidate is INDETERMINATE because critical invariants remain unverified: the dual-signature policy could not be built (GAP-O05), and interruption/atomicity evidence is missing (GAP-E10, GAP-E12). Verified aspects include successful boot in both states, rejection of wrong-key images, and that the signed factory image fits the boot partition. Unknowns include RAM/stack budget and the behavior of the transition step S0-S1. The assessment is not official and does not certify deployment.

proposals.title: Field-service reflash to replace bootloader
proposals.rationale: The blocking requirement REQ-BOOT-S0S1 is violated because the declared transition requires bootloader self-update, which is unsupported on this board. The field-service reflash plan replaces the bootloader via the debug port during a maintenance window, thereby avoiding the need for self-update and addressing the transition violation.
preconditions: Physical access to the device debug port
Technician available to perform the reflash
Backup of current bootloader and firmware images
tradeoffs: Requires manual intervention and device downtime
Not suitable for over-the-air or remote updates
May void warranty or require service contract
evidence_still_needed: Confirm that the debug port reflash procedure is supported on the target board
Verify that the new bootloader image is correctly signed and accepted by the hardware

proposals.title: Staged hybrid dual-signature bootloader
proposals.rationale: The invariant INV-I3 is unknown because the dual-signature build failed and the AND/OR policy was not observed. The staged hybrid plan ships an intermediate bootloader that verifies both ECDSA and ML-DSA signatures, which directly addresses the dual-policy gap and could resolve the unknown status of INV-I3.
preconditions: A working dual-signature build on the pinned commit
Ability to sign firmware with both ECDSA and ML-DSA keys
Bootloader storage sufficient for both public keys and verification logic
tradeoffs: Increases bootloader complexity and code size
Requires a second migration step to remove ECDSA later
May increase boot time due to dual verification
evidence_still_needed: O05 behavioral dual signature matrix on the frozen commit
Verification that the bootloader accepts both signature types in AND/OR mode
Performance measurements for dual signature verification
